name: Animation Probe A
author: Edgemodders
description: REDcode's animation Probe A (docs/research/animation-authoring.md): plays a game clip, the same clip imported back unchanged, and a copy with the left arm raised in Blender, on a spawned Trauma Team paramedic through a written workspot, to see whether an imported clip plays in the game. Asks for the bridge and archives permissions.
